spec.description: Per-prompt Claude Code activity from OTel log events: permission modes, skills, slash commands, tools and API requests.

spec.title: Cache Read Share
spec.description: Share of input-side tokens served from the prompt cache: cache reads / (input + cache reads + cache writes). Higher is cheaper.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.cache_read_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(p.input_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens), 0) AS "Cache read share"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Prompt Size Distribution
spec.description: How many prompts made N API requests, and how many made N tool calls.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT b.label AS "Calls per prompt",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.api_request_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "API requests",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.tool_call_count BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Tool calls"
FROM (
  SELECT 0 AS ord, '0' AS label, 0 AS lo, 0 AS hi
  UNION ALL SELECT 1, '1', 1, 1
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, '2-3', 2, 3
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, '4-7', 4, 7
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, '8-15', 8, 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, '16-31', 16, 31
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, '32+', 32, 1000000000
) AS b
CROSS JOIN ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY b.ord, b.label
ORDER BY b.ord

spec.title: Prompt Duration (p50 / p90)
spec.description: Wall-clock time from the prompt to its last recorded event, per day. Prompts with no model request, such as local slash commands, are excluded.

spec.rawSql:
WITH durations AS (
  SELECT DATE(p.started_at) AS day,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.started_at, p.ended_at) / 1000000 AS secs
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND p.api_request_count > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT day, secs, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY day, secs IS NULL ORDER BY secs) AS pr
  FROM durations
)
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(day) AS time,
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN secs END) AS "p50",
  MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.9 THEN secs END) AS "p90"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Error and Rejection Rates
spec.description: API error rate = API errors / (requests + errors). Tool failure rate = failed tool results / tool calls. Tool rejection rate = rejected tool uses / (tool calls + rejections).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  SUM(p.api_error_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.api_request_count + p.api_error_count), 0) AS "API error rate",
  SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0) AS "Tool failure rate",
  SUM(p.tool_reject_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count + p.tool_reject_count), 0) AS "Tool rejection rate"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at))
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Prompts With and Without Subagents
spec.description: Compares prompts that started at least one subagent with prompts that did not.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.api_request_count) AS "API requests per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.subagent_count > 0 THEN 'With subagents' ELSE 'No subagents' END
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

spec.title: Models Used per Prompt

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.models_used, ''), '(no model request)') AS "Models",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"

  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Cost"

spec.title: Slash Command Usage
spec.description: Prompts per slash command.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CONCAT('/', p.command_name) AS "Command",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND p.command_name <> ''
GROUP BY p.command_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20

spec.title: Top Skills by Trigger
spec.description: Prompts per skill, split by how the skill was invoked. 'unknown' means it was only seen on an API request or Skill tool call.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT s.skill_name AS "Skill",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'user-slash') AS "user-slash",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'claude-proactive') AS "claude-proactive",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger = 'nested-skill') AS "nested-skill",
  SUM(s.invocation_trigger NOT IN ('user-slash', 'claude-proactive', 'nested-skill')) AS "unknown"
FROM ai_prompt_skills s
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.session_id = s.session_id AND p.prompt_id = s.prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY s.skill_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 20

spec.title: Skill Adoption

SELECT p.permission_mode AS "Mode",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS "Share",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / COUNT(*) AS "Cost per prompt",
  AVG(p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens per prompt",
  AVG(p.tool_call_count) AS "Tool calls per prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p

  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})

GROUP BY p.permission_mode
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

spec.title: Mode Transitions
spec.description: Every permission mode switch, grouped by from mode, to mode and what triggered it. Running /plan counts as entering plan mode.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.from_mode, ''), '(session start)') AS "From",
  m.to_mode AS "To",
  m.`trigger` AS "Trigger",
  COUNT(*) AS "Changes",
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_permission_mode_changes m
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.changed_at)
  AND m.session_id IN (SELECT p.session_id FROM ai_prompts p WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(m.user_email, ''), m.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(m.from_mode, ''), '(session start)'), m.to_mode, m.`trigger`
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

spec.title: Mode Observed vs Inferred
spec.description: Whether a prompt's mode came from a reported mode change (observed) or was assumed to be 'default' because the session reported none (inferred).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN p.permission_mode_inferred THEN 'Inferred' ELSE 'Observed' END AS "Mode source",
  COUNT(*) AS "Prompts"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.permission_mode_inferred THEN 'Inferred' ELSE 'Observed' END

spec.title: Sessions

spec.title: Prompt Usage by User
spec.description: Per-user prompt volume, cost and habits.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS "User",
  u.team AS "Team",
  u.prompts AS "Prompts",
  u.sessions AS "Sessions",
  u.cost AS "Cost",
  u.cost / u.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  u.plan_share AS "Plan mode",
  u.skill_share AS "Used a skill",
  u.command_share AS "Slash command",
  u.tool_failure_rate AS "Tool failure rate"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    AVG(p.permission_mode = 'plan') AS plan_share,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share,
    AVG(p.command_name <> '') AS command_share,
    SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0) AS tool_failure_rate
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = p.source_connection_id
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)
) u
ORDER BY u.prompts DESC

spec.title: Active Users
spec.description: Distinct users who sent at least one prompt.

spec.rawSql:

FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)

  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

spec.title: Cost per Prompt

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Cost per Prompt"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

spec.title: API Requests per Prompt

SELECT AVG(p.api_request_count) AS "API Requests per Prompt"

WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)

  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})

spec.title: Prompts per Day by Permission Mode
spec.description: Prompts per day, split by the permission mode they ran in. 'default' includes sessions that never reported a mode change.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)) AS time,
  p.permission_mode AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(p.started_at)), p.permission_mode
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Estimated Cost by Permission Mode
spec.description: Total estimated cost of the prompts run in each permission mode.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT p.permission_mode AS "Mode",
  SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS "Cost (USD)"
FROM ai_prompts p
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY p.permission_mode
ORDER BY SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) DESC

spec.title: Prompt Usage by Repository
spec.description: Prompts, sessions, users and cost per repository the prompt ran in, from the origin remote Claude Code reports. '(no repository)' means the session had no origin remote or the client did not report one. DevLake project is filled when the repository is also collected by a DevLake project.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(r.repository_url, '(no repository)') AS "Repository",
  dl.projects AS "DevLake project",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  r.prompts / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.sessions AS "Sessions",
  r.users AS "Users",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.tokens / r.prompts AS "Tokens per prompt",
  r.skill_share AS "Used a skill"
FROM (
  SELECT p.repository_url,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)) AS users,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(p.input_tokens + p.output_tokens + p.cache_read_tokens + p.cache_creation_tokens) AS tokens,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY p.repository_url
) r
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url is lowercased with the .git suffix dropped, so normalize repos.url the same way.
  SELECT TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url)) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  GROUP BY TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY r.prompts DESC

spec.name: project
spec.label: DevLake project

spec.__legacyStringValue:

FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name

INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
